subject: draw textual annotations with theme fonts?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: draw textual annotations with theme fonts?
parts:
Hi!

To solve my plotting problem, I need to extend ggplot2 by a geom which plots text, positioned with native coordinates of the grid viewport (npc). Now, how can I plot text in the style of some theme texts? Is there a guide on how to extend ggplot?

Thanks a lot,

Sebastian

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: draw textual annotations with theme fonts?
parts:
Hi,

a search for "theme_render" in ggplot2 sources may provide some hints

p = qplot(1,1) + theme_bw(50)
theme = plot_theme(p)
g = theme_render(theme, "strip.text.x","test")
grid.draw(g)

but I'm not sure how one could (should?) use this information in a
geom. Yet another dodgy hack might be,


GeomTest <- proto(Geom, {

draw <- function(., data, scales, coordinates, theme=theme_grey(), ...) {
with(data, {
my.label = theme_render(theme, "strip.text.x", label)
my.label = editGrob(my.label, x= unit(x, "npc"), y = unit(y,
"npc"), hjust=hjust, vjust=vjust)
gTree(children=gList(
rectGrob(x,y,default.units="npc",width=1.5*grobWidth(my.label),height=1.5*grobHeight(my.label),
gp=gpar(fill="grey90"), hjust=hjust,vjust=vjust),
my.label))
}
)
}
objname <- "test"

default_stat <- function(.) StatIdentity
required_aes <- c("x", "y", "label")
default_aes <- function(.) aes(hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5)
guide_geom <- function(x) "blank"


})

geom_test <- GeomTest$build_accessor()


p = qplot(x,y,data=data.frame(x=1:4,y=1:4,f=letters[1:2]), facets=~f) +
theme_bw(20)

theme = plot_theme(p)

p + geom_test(aes(label=label), theme=theme, vjust=0, hjust=1,
data.frame(x=rep(1,2), y=rep(0,2), f=factor(letters[1:2]),
label=LETTERS[1:2]))


HTH,

baptiste
